## Read the raw MusicBrainz results

Run this notebook after Step 9 of `01_acquire.Rmd` completes and updates `musicbrainz_multiple_songs.csv`.

```{r read-musicbrainz}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

musicbrainz <- read_csv(
  "../data/raw/musicbrainz_multiple_songs.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    searched_title = col_character(),
    searched_artist = col_character(),
    title = col_character(),
    recording_id = col_character(),
    first_release_date = col_character(),
    release_year = col_integer()
  )
)

glimpse(musicbrainz)
```

## Standardize text and check duplicates

Treat each combination of searched title, searched artist, and recording ID as one candidate match. Keep distinct recording IDs for the same search so they can be reviewed against the original release.

```{r check-musicbrainz}
musicbrainz_standardized <- musicbrainz |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(searched_title, searched_artist, title, recording_id),
      trimws
    )
  )

duplicate_matches <- musicbrainz_standardized |>
  count(searched_title, searched_artist, recording_id, name = "rows") |>
  filter(rows > 1)

duplicate_matches
```

## Clean and summarize the candidate recordings

```{r clean-musicbrainz}
musicbrainz_clean <- musicbrainz_standardized |>
  distinct(searched_title, searched_artist, recording_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

tibble(
  raw_rows = nrow(musicbrainz),
  cleaned_rows = nrow(musicbrainz_clean),
  duplicate_rows_removed = nrow(musicbrainz) - nrow(musicbrainz_clean),
  missing_release_years = sum(is.na(musicbrainz_clean$release_year))
)

musicbrainz_clean |>
  count(searched_title, searched_artist, name = "candidate_recordings")
```

Release years are the dates reported for candidate recordings. Keep missing years as `NA` and verify the original recording and release date separately before calculating age at resurgence.

## Save the cleaned data

```{r save-musicbrainz}
dir.create(
  "../data/processed",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write_csv(
  musicbrainz_clean,
  "../data/processed/musicbrainz_recordings_clean.csv"
)
```
